title: Normalized benchmark web run
description: Primary benchmark-web-run.json contract consumed by CI. It contains the complete prompt, run totals, display rounds, harness evidence, diff summary, and grouped metadata.

schema.description: Contract discriminator. run.v1 is the original rewrite contract; web-run.v1 is the normalized debug contract.

agent.description: Canonical public agent ID including model and effort.

taskName.description: Task title or stable task label.

sessionName.description: Run/session name. Current normalized data uses the same value as id.

title.description: Run title shown on the run page; it identifies the run, not only the task.

prompt.description: Task-starting user prompt. The website treats this as user information.

text.description: Complete prompt with Markdown and line breaks preserved.

sourcePath.description: Optional relative artifact path for the prompt.

source.description: Run-level metrics and pricing calculated before website generation.

url.description: Source repository or benchmark artifact URL.

model.description: Real model used by the run.

steps.description: Agent round/step count used by run summary UI.

costUsd.description: Total run cost in USD, or null when provider usage was not recovered.

pricing.description: Pricing audit record containing rates, billable token categories, source URL, tier, and context band.

costUsd.description: Calculated USD cost; must match source.costUsd within rounding precision.

source.description: Authoritative pricing source URL or versioned mapping ID.

model.description: Normalized model matched by the pricing table.

requestedModel.description: Model name requested by the run before pricing normalization.

tier.description: API service tier used by the price mapping.

context.description: Context pricing band such as short or long.

ratesPer1M.description: Input, cached-input, and output USD rates per one million tokens.

billableTokens.description: Pricing token categories. Names follow the pricing tool output and represent input/cachedInput/output/reasoning/total.

inputTokens.description: Deduplicated run input tokens, or null when unavailable.

outputTokens.description: Deduplicated run output tokens, or null when unavailable.

reasoningTokens.description: Reasoning subset of output tokens, or null when unavailable.

cacheInputTokens.description: Cached subset of input tokens, or null when unavailable.

totalTokens.description: inputTokens + outputTokens, or null when unavailable.

peakContext.description: Maximum single-request input/context size when available.

durationSeconds.description: Measured run duration. Omit or null when unavailable.

rawArtifactStatus.description: Short provenance note about source normalization.

model.description: Model field used by the original run.v1 contract.

rounds.description: Ordered display rounds. Complete messages and commands are preserved.

harness.description: Website-ready harness rows derived from harness-report.results.

assertion.description: Exact assertion or rule name displayed by the website.

repoDiff.description: Optional parsed diff rows. The current Repo tab uses the repo browser instead of relying on this array.

metadata.description: Grouped metadata rendered as labeled fields rather than raw JSON.

common.description: Category, report, task, and run IDs common to all producers.

custom.description: Producer-specific provenance. Custom fields are isolated here so common metadata remains stable.

result_tabs.description: Available category descriptors; debug/rewrite do not create a separate Results tab.

contract_paths.description: Relative links to normalized contract files.
